           CASCARILLA

         Sweet Bark


Acts on the digestive tract; constipation. Aversion to smell of tobacco.   Inclination to vomit   very marked.



Stomach.--  Hunger after meals. Desire for hot drinks.   Nausea and vomiting  . Pain in stomach as from a shock. Pressing
        colic.



Rectum.--  Constipation; stools hard, covered with mucus (  Graph  ). Bright blood with stool. Diarrhœa alternating with
        hard, lumpy stool, with backache and lassitude, preceded by griping. Gnawing pain high up in
        rectum.



Dose.--  First to third potency.
